registry.preferred_name: Radioiodine-refractory vesicular thyroid carcinoma (VTC) with sinonasal metastasis
support_spans: A woman in her 30s with no relevant medical history was referred for a progressive bilateral nasal airway obstruction.
Endoscopic examination found a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities.
A hypervascular and pulsatile tumor occupies almost the entire right nasal fossa
Enhanced CT scan showed a hypervascular tumor in the nasal cavity, on the left thyroid, the fifth rib, and the L4 vertebra
contradict_spans: The sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
